messages: Keep up to date with the latest community news - covering DeepRacer and AI League alike - by reading the AWS AI/ML Community Blog at https://blog.awsaicommunity.org/.
Need assistance? Join the AWS AI/ML Community on Discord at https://discord.gg/FrEUMsZrAZ.
The AWS DeepRacer console has been replaced by DeepRacer on AWS — train, evaluate and race with your group, just as before. Read about it at https://docs.aws.amazon.com/solutions/deepracer-on-aws/.
